findings.evidence: Very large finite timeouts (>= ~2147484 s, huge ints) passed validation, then raised OverflowError mid-run (exit 1, traceback, no evidence); a 400-digit int crashed math.isfinite inside validate().
findings.impact: Config error surfaced as a mid-run crash after earlier commands ran.
findings.suggested_fix: Upper bound MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1_000_000 via chained comparison; documented in README and toml.

findings.evidence: Timeout partial output was not newline-translated like text=True output.
findings.impact: \r kept in timeout evidence; lengths differ.

findings.evidence: Windows hang risk (post-kill communicate() waits for a grandchild holding the pipe) was not documented.
findings.impact: Windows users may over-trust the timeout.

findings.evidence: No unit test for decode_partial (str branch, locale encoding); POSIX-only harness had no skip marker; legacy expectations are hand-written rather than run against baseline.
findings.impact: Gaps in evidence for QT-TO-006 and QT-COMP-001.
findings.suggested_fix: Added test_coerce_timeout_output*, module-level skipif. Legacy test kept hand-written (derived from 4020eaa, recorded in verification).

findings.evidence: An unspecified '(dry run; timeout Ns)' console line was added.
findings.suggested_fix: Removed; the timeout is reported in evidence.

findings.evidence: Non-table command entries -> AttributeError; completed command with undecodable bytes -> UnicodeDecodeError. Both at baseline.
findings.impact: Crash with exit 1 and no evidence (baseline behaviour).
findings.suggested_fix: Follow-up: validate entry type; errors='replace' in subprocess.run.

findings.evidence: The 1000000 maximum was documented only for default_timeout_seconds, but it also applies to per-command timeout_seconds.
findings.suggested_fix: Document the maximum for both fields.
